summary: Cosan S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its reviewed condensed interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, along with an independent auditor's review report. The filing includes standard interim financial disclosures such as balance sheet, income statement, cash flows, and notes. No special-situation corporate event is announced or described. There are no M&A terms, activist campaigns, board changes, or restructuring plans. This is a routine periodic financial report filed by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q.
